name: Innovation Sprint
description: The Innovation Sprint program runs on a five-day, intensive Design Thinking sprint, during which interdisciplinary student teams tackle real-world challenges provided by diverse industry partners. Throughout these five days, students learn and apply all the steps of the Design Thinking process — starting from an unfamiliar problem and culminating in a pitch-ready solution. Additionally, students are required to submit a reflection paper detailing their personal growth during the sprint.
prerequisites: Interest in entrepreneurship, ability to work in a team.
